name: C# Code Studio
description: Interactive in-app C# development and automation studio featuring a dedicated project/script manager, syntax-highlighted editor, real-time Roslyn compilation diagnostics, and in-memory execution.
longDescription:
Bring full-featured C# development and script automation directly into your document studio! This studio tool provides a dual-page workflow: a Script Management Hub to organize and template your scripts, and a dedicated C# Code Studio powered by AvaloniaEdit and Roslyn.

### Key Features:
• **Two-Page Architecture**: Dedicated Script Hub to browse, search, and duplicate scripts alongside a full-featured Code Studio editor.
• **Hardware-Accelerated Code Editor**: Built on Avalonia.AvaloniaEdit with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and dark IDE styling.
• **Real-Time Roslyn Diagnostics**: Debounced background syntax and semantic analysis with clickable error/warning navigation.
• **Live In-Memory Execution**: Compiles and runs C# code in an isolated worker with real-time Console.Out/Console.Error terminal streaming.
• **Starter Template Library**: Ready-to-run templates for PDF Document Automation, LINQ Benchmarking, and JSON Serialization.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Workspace Navigation (Full Viewport Studio), Command Palette (Ctrl+Alt+E), Status Bar ({ } C# Studio), and Ribbon.
highlights: Two-Page Workflow: Script Management Hub & Full Code Studio
Hardware-Accelerated C# Editor Powered by Avalonia.AvaloniaEdit
Real-Time Background Roslyn Diagnostics & Error Navigation
In-Memory Execution Engine with Live Console Output Streaming
Pre-loaded Starter Templates for PDF Automation & LINQ Benchmarking

versions.releaseNotes: Release v1.0.6 of C# Code Studio.

Blind 75 problems browser with filtering, sorting, resizable columns, LeetCode deep-links, automated test case generation, script problem test runner UI, dump table sequence formatting, and UI snapshot tools.

Comprehensive visualizer framework: data structure visualizers (arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, stacks, queues), recursion call-tree tracking, step-by-step playback, and new design patterns, testing, and debugging tutorials in the documentation center.

Theme consistency & Learn C# center: migrated hardcoded colors to DynamicResource, added Learn C# tutorials (HttpClient, async/await, file I/O, threading), added CodeViewer syntax-highlighted code blocks, cross-cell notebook completions, cell onModified tracking, Nexus-themed manager views, modular sidebar/header controls, deadlock prevention & execution timeout recovery, unlimited default timeout.
Stability release: unhandled exception handlers and code completion robustness fallbacks.

name: Chess
description: Interactive floating Chess game overlay featuring single player vs smart CPU AI opponent and local pass-and-play.
longDescription:
Bring intellectual gaming into your document studio! This extension provides a full-featured, playable Chess game directly inside a floating shell overlay.

### Key Features:
• **Floating Draggable Shell Overlay**: Runs smoothly on top of any document workspace without interrupting your PDF work.
• **Single Player vs Smart CPU**: Configurable AI difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard) powered by off-thread alpha-beta minimax search.
• **Full FIDE Chess Rules**: Standard legal move validation, castling, en passant, and interactive pawn promotion (Queen, Rook, Bishop, Knight).
• **Captured Pieces & Material Advantage**: Real-time captured pieces display and point advantage tracker (+3, +1).
• **Material 3 Expressive Board Themes**: Emerald Studio, Classic Wood, and Midnight Slate high-contrast themes.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette (Ctrl+Alt+C), Status Bar (♟️ Chess), and Ribbon View Tab.

name: Image Editor
description: A Canva-style layered design editor: fill/stroke/gradient styling, layers panel, grouping, free rotation, smart guides, inline text editing, an 8-template gallery, and project save/load.
longDescription:
Compose graphics directly inside your PDF workspace with a full-featured, resizable floating design editor.

### Key Features:
• **Layer-based Canvas**: Stack Text, Rectangle, Ellipse, Arrow, and imported Images in Z-order, with a clickable Layers panel (visibility/lock/rename), multi-select, marquee-select, grouping, and align/distribute.
• **Full Style Controls**: Fill & stroke color pickers, gradient fills (linear/radial), stroke width/dash style, corner radius, opacity, and precise numeric X/Y/Width/Height/Rotation fields.
• **Click-to-Place Tools & Eyedropper**: Click or drag directly on the canvas to place shapes and text, or sample any on-canvas color with the eyedropper — with V/T/R/E/A keyboard shortcuts.
• **Free-Angle Rotation & Group Resize**: Drag-to-rotate any single element or a whole multi-selection around a shared pivot (15° Shift-snap), plus proportional group resizing.
• **Smart Alignment Guides & Inline Text Editing**: Snapping guide lines while dragging, plus double-click-to-edit text directly on the canvas.
• **Undo/Redo**: Full edit history across every mutation — moves, resizes, rotations, crops, grouping, and color adjustments.
• **Zoom & Pan**: Smooth cursor-anchored zoom, pan, and fit-to-window on a resizable canvas.
• **Per-Image Crop, Rotate & Flip**: Precise crop handles with fixed-aspect presets (1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16), 90° rotation, and horizontal/vertical flip, with aspect-ratio lock.
• **Deep Color Adjustments & 9 Filters**: Brightness/contrast/saturation/hue/temperature/tint/blur/sharpen sliders, one-click Auto-Enhance, and Black & White, Sepia, Vintage, Vivid, Noir, Invert, Duotone, and Vignette presets.
• **Duplicate, Copy & Paste**: Ctrl+D to duplicate and an in-app Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V element clipboard.
• **Template Gallery**: 8 starter templates — slide, certificate, flyer, photo collage, quote card, cover page, social post, and sticky note — each with a live-rendered preview.
• **Project Save/Load**: Save and reopen full editable projects as `.fryimg` files, with a confirm-before-discard safeguard.
• **PNG Export & Clipboard**: Export the full canvas to PNG, or copy it as a real image directly to the system clipboard.
• **Material 3 Expressive UI**: Fully theme-adaptive light/dark interface with segmented tool selectors and tactile sliders.
• **Shell Integration**: Command Palette (`Ctrl+Alt+I`), Status Bar pill, and Ribbon button.
